data.name: Cushion the Blow
data.description: As long as you are maintaining psoinic focus, as an immediate action, you can minimize the damage of a single attack with a ranged, melee, or natural weapon or unarmed strike (treat all dice rolled as 1s) on any member of the collective.  This ability must be used in response to an attack on a member of the collective.  In addition, if you expend your psionic focus, you can reduce any additional damage on the attack (such as bonus damage from a high Strength or sneak attack damage) by your key ability modifier.
